description: Plan a multi-stop ski road trip: picks the top-scoring resorts in a region, orders them into a drivable route (nearest-neighbour, minimal backtracking), allocates your days across stops, estimates each driving leg, and folds in live conditions plus chain-control where covered. Args: region (required), days, optional pass.

pass.description: Optional ski pass to limit stops (e.g. epic, ikon)

region.description: europe | north-america | asia | oceania | south-america | alps | rockies | japan | any

name: plan_ski_road_trip

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Plan a ski road trip
